cards.name: T-money Transit Card
cards.where_to_buy: All convenience stores (CU, GS25, 7-Eleven, Emart24) and subway station ticket machines.
cards.where_to_recharge: Convenience stores or subway station machines (CASH ONLY in KRW for standard T-money).
cards.coverage: Subways, buses, taxis, and convenience stores nationwide across all of South Korea (Seoul, Busan, Gyeongju, Jeju, Jeonju).
cards.best_for: Every traveler! This is the mandatory baseline card in Korea.
cards.sf_japan_equivalent: Direct equivalent to SF Clipper Card or Japan Suica / Pasmo / ICOCA.
cards.pro_tip: Always tap ON when boarding and tap OFF when exiting buses and subways to get free/discounted transfers within 30 minutes!

cards.name: WOWPASS (All-in-One Tourist Prepaid Debit + T-money)
cards.type: All-in-One Foreigner Payment Card + Transit Card
cards.where_to_buy: WOWPASS Kiosks at Incheon Airport, Seoul Station, major subway stations, and hotels.
cards.where_to_recharge: Insert USD/EUR/JPY/GBP cash into kiosk to top up KRW debit balance; top up T-money transit balance at convenience stores or subway machines.
cards.coverage: Accepted as a regular IC debit card at 99% of shops, cafes, restaurants in Korea + built-in T-money IC chip for subways/buses.
cards.best_for: First-time foreign tourists who want to avoid carrying stacks of KRW cash while getting competitive exchange rates.
cards.sf_japan_equivalent: Like a Suica card combined with an international tourist debit card.
cards.pro_tip: Download the official WOWPASS iPhone app to track your expenses in real-time, lock the card if lost, and get cashback at olive young / Starbucks.

cards.name: Seoul Climate Card (Tourist Short-Term Pass - 2026)
cards.type: Unlimited Transit Pass for Seoul Subways & Buses
cards.where_to_buy: Seoul Subway station Customer Safety Centers (Lines 1-8) and convenience stores near tourist hubs.
cards.where_to_recharge: Seoul-published tourist prices: 1-day ₩5,000, 2-day ₩8,000, 3-day ₩10,000, 5-day ₩15,000 (english.seoul.go.kr, 2024 launch; still cited in 2026 guides). A 7-day option is often listed around ₩20,000 — confirm at the machine.
cards.coverage: Unlimited rides on Seoul subways and Seoul city buses (blue, green, yellow). Excludes AREX Express, Shinbundang line, and intercity buses outside Seoul.
cards.best_for: Travelers spending 3 to 7 intensive days exploring Seoul and riding transit 3+ times per day.
cards.sf_japan_equivalent: Like the Tokyo Subway 72-hour Ticket or SF Muni 3-Day Visitor Passport, but insanely cheap.
cards.pro_tip: At 15,000 KRW for 5 days, you break even after just 10 subway rides! A massive money saver for your Seoul days.

cards.name: KORAIL Saver Pass (for Groups of 2 to 5 Travelers)
cards.type: Unlimited KTX & Korail Train Tourist Pass
cards.where_to_buy: Official KORAIL website or verified partners (Klook, Trazy).
cards.where_to_recharge: 2-Day Flexible (121,000 KRW/person) or 4-Day Flexible (224,000 KRW/person) for 2+ travelers.
cards.coverage: Unlimited KTX, ITX, and Mugunghwa train rides nationwide (excludes SRT). Includes up to 2 free seat reservations per day.
cards.best_for: Two travelers doing multi-city trips like Seoul -> Busan -> Gyeongju/Jeonju -> Seoul.
cards.sf_japan_equivalent: Direct equivalent to the Japan Rail (JR) Pass, but specifically discounted for groups of 2-5 people!
cards.pro_tip: If you buy individual roundtrip KTX tickets Seoul-Busan it costs ~119,600 KRW. The 2-Day Flexible Saver Pass is 121,000 KRW and lets you add additional intercity KTX legs for virtually zero extra cost!

cards.name: Discover Seoul Pass (DSP)
cards.where_to_recharge: Official lineup as of Aug 2026: 72-hour 90000 KRW; 120-hour 130000 KRW; Pick 3 Basic 49000 KRW; Pick 3 Theme Park 70000 KRW. Older 24h/48h SKUs may still appear on resellers.
cards.coverage: Free entry to 70+ partner attractions plus discounts. Physical card can be topped up for subway/bus; mobile pass includes a 5-day eSIM. Confirm AREX inclusion on the current product page before purchase.
cards.best_for: First-time visitors stacking several paid Seoul attractions into 3-5 days.
cards.sf_japan_equivalent: Like the San Francisco CityPASS or Osaka Amazing Pass.
cards.pro_tip: Compare the official attraction list with your actual saved list. A pass is only a saving if you would have paid those admissions anyway.

cards.name: Visit Busan Pass
cards.where_to_buy: Visit Busan Pass website, Busan Station, or Klook.
cards.where_to_recharge: Official card prices on visitbusanpass.com: 24h ₩55,000; 48h ₩85,000; Big 3 ₩45,000; Big 5 ₩65,000.
cards.coverage: Free entry to Haeundae Blue Line Park Beach Train, Busan X the Sky, Lotte World Busan, Skyline Luge + built-in transit card.
cards.best_for: 2-3 days of coastal sightseeing in Busan.
cards.sf_japan_equivalent: Direct equivalent to Osaka Amazing Pass for Busan.
cards.pro_tip: The Haeundae Beach Train and Busan X the Sky observation deck alone cover more than 70% of the 24h pass price!
